svg.title: Tuition payment | Durable intent and atomic settlement

g.text: Tuition payment | Durable intent and atomic settlement
[Worker tick every 3 seconds (independent of browser polling)]
Platform session; list pending intent IDs
[Each pending ID in its own session]
Use None / stored status; no duplicate posting
Set intent succeeded; if invoice unpaid:
mark paid + balanced ledger + unique receipt;
roll back any remaining read transaction
Read tenant intent + invoice; check ownership
Shared reconciliation body above (same row locks / atomic settlement)
Bars show request, helper and query execution; dashed arrows are returns.
Worker and browser loops may overlap; they use the same locking helper.
Database locks survive individual query bars until transaction/session end.
Balanced settlement = cash debit + revenue credit, same posting_id and equal totals.
An already-paid invoice does not receive a second posting or receipt.
Callback body is only a reference hint; provider status is authoritative.
Current gateway blocks unauthenticated callback ingress.
Poller queries status; it does not resubmit a lost MTN request.
Provider call is inside the reconciliation lock lifetime.
